title: Iron in the Storm
style: English, melodic heavy metal, powerful clear male lead vocals, gritty edge, distorted electric guitar riffs, harmonized lead guitars, driving double kick drums, strong bass, dramatic chorus, energetic and defiant, 148 BPM, complete song
lyrics:
[Verse]
The sky is full of thunder
The ground is breaking wide
We carry sparks of daylight
And keep the fire inside

[Chorus]
We are iron in the storm
We are voices in the rain
Every broken road we walk
Builds the strength to rise again

[Verse]
The towers cast their shadows
Across the empty square
We hear the morning calling
And leave our silence there

[Chorus]
We are iron in the storm
We are voices in the rain
Every broken road we walk
Builds the strength to rise again

[Outro]
Keep the fire inside
